extraction.name: OWSM v4: Improving Open Whisper-Style Speech Models via Data Scaling and Cleaning
extraction.description: The Open Whisper-style Speech Models (OWSM) project enhances fully open speech foundation models by integrating YODAS, a large-scale web-crawled dataset with a Creative Commons license. A scalable data-cleaning pipeline is developed to address challenges like incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments, yielding a dataset with 166,000 hours of speech across 75 languages. The new OWSM v4 models, trained on this curated dataset alongside existing OWSM data, significantly outperform previous versions on multilingual benchmarks and match or surpass industrial models like Whisper and MMS in multiple scenarios.
extraction.creator: Yifan Peng, Muhammad Shakeel, Yui Sudo, William Chen, Jinchuan Tian, Chyi-Jiunn Lin, Shinji Watanabe
extraction.publisher: Carnegie Mellon University, Honda Research Institute Japan
extraction.citeAs: Peng, Y., Shakeel, M., Sudo, Y., Chen, W., Tian, J., Lin, C.-J., & Watanabe, S. (2025). OWSM v4: Improving Open Whisper-Style Speech Models via Data Scaling and Cleaning. Interspeech 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The raw YODAS data was web-crawled and included unsegmented long-form recordings with text transcriptions annotated with start and end timestamps. A three-step data-cleaning pipeline was applied: (1) realignment of audio and text using a pre-trained OWSM-CTC model to segment long-form audio into shorter utterances (max 30 seconds) and remove non-speech elements, (2) language identification (LID) filtering using fastText (text-based) and ECAPA-TDNN (spoken) models to retain only utterances with matching language labels across audio and text, and (3) CTC-score-based filtering to remove low-quality audio-text alignments using a relative threshold (θCTC = 0.10) determined via fine-tuning experiments.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Software Collection, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: YODAS dataset, a large-scale web-crawled dataset with Creative Commons license, including unsegmented long-form audio recordings with text transcriptions and start/end timestamps.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The data-cleaning pipeline involved: (1) realignment of audio and text using OWSM-CTC v3.2 to segment long-form audio into 30-second utterances and remove non-speech elements, (2) LID-based filtering using fastText (text) and ECAPA-TDNN (spoken) models to retain utterances with matching language labels, and (3) CTC-score-based filtering to remove low-quality alignments using a relative threshold (θCTC = 0.10). The final dataset consists of 166,000 hours of speech across 75 languages.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset consists of audio recordings with associated text transcriptions. Annotations include language labels, start/end timestamps for transcriptions, and CTC confidence scores for alignment quality. The cleaning pipeline used public toolkits (OWSM-CTC, fastText, ECAPA-TDNN) to correct and filter annotations.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: OWSM-CTC v3.2 model, fastText (text-based LID), ECAPA-TDNN (spoken LID), and ESPnet toolkit for implementation.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: CTC confidence scores were used to rank and filter low-quality audio-text alignments. Fine-tuning experiments on cleaned data at varying thresholds (θCTC) demonstrated significant performance improvements, validating the effectiveness of the filtering process.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The cleaned YODAS data, pre-trained models, training code, and logs will be publicly released via the ESPnet toolkit. Versioning and updates are implied through the data-cleaning pipeline and model training process, but no explicit deprecation policy is mentioned.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The work aims to advance open academic research by providing fully open speech foundation models and datasets, addressing concerns about privacy, transparency, and reproducibility in proprietary models like Whisper.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset distribution is highly imbalanced, with English constituting the largest share and many other languages underrepresented. The cleaning pipeline may introduce biases based on the thresholds and models used for filtering.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is limited by the quality of the raw YODAS data, which includes incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments. The cleaning pipeline may not fully address all noise, and the final dataset retains the original language distribution without resampling. Performance varies across languages, and some languages remain underrepresented.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning for multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR), speech translation (ST), spoken language identification (LID), and voice activity detection (VAD). The dataset is intended for academic research and open-source development of speech foundation models.
